title: Per-token P&L slices: regional + model sweep
content:
Purpose:
This is a compact spreadsheet-style slice to run quick sensitivity sweeps across models and regions to expose per-token COGS, margin, and the highest-leverage optimization moves for Hosted API. It is intentionally lightweight so engineers/product can iterate on scenarios without the full workbench.

Scope and audience:
- Intended for product and infra optimization leads, solutions SRE, and finance partners who need fast answers for tradeoffs (batch size, quantization, cache hit rate, regional egress).
- Not a canonical ledger; feeds into the longer Optimize workbench after validation.

Key assumptions (baseline):
- Baseline model family: small/gpt-7b, medium/gpt-13b, large/gpt-64b (these are internal labels; map to physical variants in the workbench).
- GPU hourly cost: us-west (A100-80GB): $2.40/hr, eu-west (A100-80GB): $2.60/hr, ap-southeast (H100-80GB): $3.10/hr. These are blended across reserved and burst pools.
- Average seq length (prompt+completion): small=256, medium=512, large=1024 tokens.
- Tokens/sec per GPU (inference effective): small=1400, medium=900, large=250. These incorporate batching and kv cache behaviour at baseline.
- Network egress: us-west $0.00 (in-region), eu-west $0.02/GB, ap-southeast $0.05/GB.
- Storage / model hot-disk amortized: $0.03/hr per model replica.
- Baseline cache hit: 12% prefix cache hit for common prompts; KV warm-up removed for subsequent tokens where hit applies.
- Conversion: 1 token ~ 0.75 KB for sizing/egress approximations.

Mini spreadsheet snapshot (CSV style, use in sheet tabs):
Columns: Scenario, Region, Model, SeqLen, TokensPerSecPerGPU, GPUsNeeded (calc), HourlyGPUcost, EgressCostPerTok, StoragePerTok, COGS_per_token (calc), Price_per_token (current list), Margin_per_token
Rows (examples):
"Baseline","us-west","small","256","1400","=CEILING((256/1400)*RPS/3600,1)","$2.40/hr","$0.0000009","$0.00000003","$0.0000015","$0.000003","-0.0000015"
"Baseline","eu-west","medium","512","900","...","$2.60/hr","$0.0000016","$0.00000005","$0.0000029","$0.000006","-0.0000031"
"Quantized x4","us-west","small-q4","256","1000","...","$2.40/hr","$0.0000009","$0.00000002","$0.0000011","$0.000003","-0.0000019"
Notes on calculations (place as cell formulas in sheet):
- GPUsNeeded = traffic_tokens_per_sec / TokensPerSecPerGPU (round up, convert from requests/sec to tokens/sec per product metrics). For quick sweep assume a per-customer RPS shell (e.g., 10 rps * avg seq length) or use aggregate token demand.
- HourlyGPUcost per token = HourlyGPUcost_per_instance / (TokensPerSecPerGPU * 3600) * (1 / avg_utilization). We keep avg_utilization as a parameter (baseline 55%).
- EgressCostPerTok = (token_bytes * egress_price_per_GB) / (1024*1024*1024).
- StoragePerTok = amortized storage_per_hour / (TokensPerSecPerGPU * 3600).
- COGS_per_token = HourlyGPUcost_per_token + EgressCostPerTok * (1 - cache_hit_ratio) + StoragePerTok.

Scenario sweep knobs (columns to vary):
- Batching: baseline -> +20%/+50% effective tokens/sec (modeled multiplicatively).
- Quantization: q4/q8/float16 with corresponding tokens/sec degrades or improves and possible model accuracy/regression risk.
- Cache hit: 5% / 12% / 35% / 60% (affects egress and KV compute).
- Price shock: regional egress +/- 30%, GPU price +/- 20% (reserve vs burst mix).
- Traffic tail: increase in average seq length +20% (affects tokens consumed).

Example sensitivity table to attach as second tab:
- Rows: Model x Region combos. Columns: Baseline COGS/token, +20% batching COGS/token, q4 COGS/token, 35% cache COGS/token, Combined best COGS/token.
- Delta columns: absolute $ delta and % delta relative to baseline.

Quick prioritization (first-order guidance):
1) Improve batching heuristics (medium effort, high impact): target +30% throughput on medium models. Estimated COGS reduction 18–28% for medium workloads. Confidence: medium-high.
2) Opportunistic quantization for cheap read-only endpoints (low effort to experiment, medium risk): q4 yields 12–22% COGS reduction but requires QA/regressions.
3) Prefix cache improvements (product + runtime): raising cache hit from 12% -> 35% reduces egress + repeated compute ~ 6–15% overall COGS depending on prompt length distribution. Confidence: medium.
4) Regional routing by model variant (policy + price): send latency-tolerant bulk requests for large models to lower-cost regions with fallback. Implementation complexity: high. Potential savings: up to 20% blended across global traffic.
5) Reserved capacity tuning (finance + infra): commit vs burst mix optimization could reduce blended GPU hr cost by ~8–12% if commit capture rate increases.

Quick wins (actionable items):
- Run q4 trial for small model on non-production namespace with representative eval prompts (JIRA-OPT-142). Gather quality regressions and per-token perf.
- Adjust default batch timeout from 10ms -> 15ms in mid-tier routing for 2-week experiment. Track tokens/sec uplift and tail latency.
- Add a light-weight prefix cache telemetry tag to Hosted API responses (flag sample set) so we can estimate real RW hit fraction across customers.
- Temporary regional price floor: if eu egress > $0.03/GB, route non-SLA requests to us-west where possible.

Risks and caveats:
- Per-token COGS is sensitive to utilization assumptions. Underestimating tail variance (short bursts, low-utilization wallets) will overstate savings. Add a "low utilization stress" scenario.
- Quantization changes can alter user-facing quality non-linearly. Always pair with prompt-based eval sets.
- Some model architectures do not scale linearly with batch size; per-model profiling is required.

Open questions / data needed:
- Precise token distribution per customer tier (free, dev, paid) across regions — currently estimated.
- Realized tokens/sec per GPU for q4/q8 variants on H100 vs A100 (profiling incomplete for new kernels).
- True in-region egress mix (what fraction is cross-region) for last 90 days.

Next steps / owner checklist:
- [Priya] Wire a quick sheet with the above CSV snapshot and parameter sliders.
- [Marcus] Run q4 benchmark for small/medium on eu-west H100 and push perf numbers back to the sheet (due 2026-03-20).
- [Ana] Add sample selector for prefix cache telemetry and instrument for a 2% traffic slice (due 2026-03-17).
- [Dylan] Produce a short ops-runbook for routing by region (low-risk policy) for review (due 2026-03-24).

Data sources / references:
- internal: /data/metrics/hosted_api_tokens_90d (aggregate token volumes)
- internal ticket: JIRA-OPT-142 (q4 experiment)
- Confluence pages: Hosted API Unit Econ Home (linked above)

Contact and context:
- If you want a deeper worksheet that ties into billing and customer tier, see Optimize workbench (linked). This sheet is deliberately small — use it to validate direction and estimate ROIs for bigger investments.
